messages.author: 9e8f9b870a2e6cdf
messages.subject: Re: geom_points data capacity?
parts:
Hoi,

The following

require(ggplot2)
zz <- data.frame( xx <- runif(n=750000 ), yy <- runif(n=750000) )
ggplot(zz,aes(x=xx,y=yy))+geom_point()

takes about a minute to plot on my machine ( dual core, 4Gig )

But with so many point you might want to use a different kind of plot,
or just plot a sample of data.

If you save such a plot as pdf it will take a very long time to render too.


Frans.

I get similar timings:

> system.time(print(ggplot(zz,aes(x=xx,y=yy))+geom_point()))
user system elapsed
18.78 10.31 29.12
> benchplot(ggplot(zz,aes(x=xx,y=yy))+geom_point())
step user.self sys.self elapsed
1 construct 0.05 0.03 0.08
2 build 7.84 0.75 8.62
3 render 4.58 1.00 5.59
4 draw 3.39 8.60 12.02
5 TOTAL 15.86 10.38 26.31

Quad core, 16GB, 64 bit Windows 7, running just Rterm.

You may be having memory issues (though 750,000 * 4 bytes * 2 dimenions
~ 6MB, so I would doubt that), or it may be related to Rstudio (I
believe that Rstudio has its own graphics device, but I may be recalling
that incorrectly).

> But with so many point you might want to use a different kind of plot,
> or just plot a sample of data.
>
> If you save such a plot as pdf it will take a very long time to render too.

Both of these are very good points.

I entered the code below

p

but my machine simply freezes, obviously doing a lot of work but producing nothing. Eventually I had to kill RStudio. Is the scale of the data an issue here? (there's ~750k rows of data)
